description: This file is a PHP source file responsible for rendering the header section of the Vtiger CRM interface, including setting up Smarty templates, loading user and module information, and linking external resources.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty class used for rendering templates within Vtiger CRM.

classes.name: Tracker
classes.description: A class for tracking recent user activity within the CRM.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: Handles date and time display formatting.

classes.name: Vtiger_Link
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve various types of links for the CRM UI.

methods.name: getFullNameFromArray
methods.description: Retrieves the full name of a user from an array of user data.

methods.name: getHeaderArray
methods.description: Generates an array of header entries for display.

methods.name: getQuickCreateModules
methods.description: Returns modules available for quick creation.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Returns the current parent tab or category for navigation.

methods.name: getMenuStructure
methods.description: Provides the structure of the main menu.

methods.name: get_use_asterisk
methods.description: Returns whether to use asterisk for some UI indication.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Determines if a user has administrative privileges.

methods.name: getAllByType
methods.description: Retrieves all links of specific types for the module.

methods.name: decode_html
methods.description: Decodes HTML special characters in a string.
